course.title: CMS Program
course.subtitle: 葡萄种植与酿造
course.reviewStatus: 学员学习稿 · 待教师终审

lessons.title: 气候、坡向与水分
lessons.body:
**概念与背景 · ** Climate 是较长时期的气候特征，weather 是某个季节或几天的实际天气。Aspect 是葡萄园坡面朝向；水分可用性取决于降水、土壤持水能力、排水和管理等。

**影响因素 · ** 葡萄需要光合作用来积累糖，成熟过程中酸度和风味也发生变化。**热量、光照、水分不是同一变量。**

**作用机制 · ** 凉爽生长季通常使糖积累和成熟较慢，并常保留较高酸度；温暖可以促进成熟，但极端高温和干旱可能抑制光合作用、造成日灼或失水。坡向改变日照；北半球朝南坡通常得到更多太阳辐射，南半球方向相反，但要结合地形。

**结果与取舍 · ** 同一品种在两处园址可能呈现不同糖度、酸度、酒精潜力、风味成熟和病害压力。好排水防止长期积水，**适度的可用水仍不可缺少**。

**品鉴联系 · ** 较凉、成熟适度的果实可能带来更高酸度和清新果香；温暖成熟的果实可能有更成熟的果香和较高潜在酒精。以上是趋势，不是凭风格就能倒推唯一气候。

**辨析 · ** Climate vs weather；sunlight vs temperature；well-drained vs dry。

lessons.title: 葡萄藤、嫁接与整形
lessons.body:
**概念 · ** Variety 品种；clone 同品种内经无性繁殖选出的株系；crossing 通常指同种双亲杂交；interspecific hybrid 指不同物种之间的杂交。Rootstock 是砧木，scion 是接穗。

**学习依据 · ** 许多 V. vinifera 品种的自根对根瘤蚜敏感，而合适的砧木可提供抗性、适应土壤条件。保留果实风格的接穗品种与根系功能可以分开选择。

**过程与机制 · ** **Grafting 嫁接将两个植株组织接合**，不会令它们的遗传物质混合成一个新杂交品种。Training 是多年生结构及枝条布局；pruning 决定留下多少结果枝芽；canopy management 管理生长季叶片和新梢。

**结果与取舍 · ** 有助于健康生长、产量、通风、光照和操作，但没有一种方式适合所有地区。

**品鉴联系 · ** 通过成熟与树冠环境间接影响糖酸及果实质量，不能声称每种架式有唯一固定香气。

**辨析 · ** clone vs crossing；grafting vs hybridisation；training vs pruning。

lessons.title: 生长周期与霜冻
lessons.body:
**概念 · ** Dormancy → budburst → shoot growth / flowering → fruit set → véraison → ripening → harvest → leaf fall / dormancy.

**学习依据 · ** 每一步决定潜在收成或成熟程度；刚萌发的组织特别容易受春霜伤害，开花期恶劣天气可能影响坐果。

**过程与机制 · ** 风机在有合适逆温层时可帮助混合空气；喷水利用水结冰释放潜热保护组织，但需满足条件并连续正确运行；选址、冷空气流动及推迟修剪等可能有帮助。**Buttage 主要用于覆盖藤基等冬季保护场景**，不是普通的春季防芽霜通用工具。

**结果与取舍 · ** 霜冻可能减少产量，成熟期的热量或降雨影响糖、酸、腐烂风险及采收。

**品鉴联系 · ** 决定可采果实条件，不可把「年份凉」当成「一定高品质/一定不成熟」。

lessons.title: 病害、贵腐与干缩
lessons.body:
**概念 · ** Phylloxera 是昆虫害虫；powdery mildew 为真菌性病害；downy mildew 病原为卵菌；Botrytis cinerea 是真菌。

**学习依据 · ** 病害可损伤叶、枝、果，影响成熟、产量和果实健康。**Botrytis** 在合适条件下可能造成有利的 noble rot，也可能造成破坏性的灰腐。

**过程与机制 · ** 贵腐常需要潮湿条件发生感染及随后较干燥条件使葡萄逐渐失水；果实状态不均时可能分批选摘。**Passerillage** 指在藤上或采后干缩，不能直接等同感染贵腐。

**结果与取舍 · ** 失水通常浓缩糖与其他成分，但不自动保证成酒是甜的，因为发酵可以消耗糖。

**辨析 · ** noble rot vs grey rot；passerillage vs botrytis。

lessons.title: 采收与红白酿造
lessons.body:
**概念 · ** Typical WHITE: harvest → optionally destem/crush → **press** → clarify juice → ferment → mature → bottle. Typical RED: harvest → optionally destem/crush → **ferment on skins** with extraction → drain/press → mature → bottle.

**学习依据 · ** 葡萄果肉含大部分水、糖、酸；果皮贡献大量红色色素与部分单宁、香气成分。**皮与液体接触的时机和方式是核心差异。**

**过程与机制 · ** White 通常先分开皮和汁再发酵，Red 通常带皮发酵；但是存在白葡萄带皮酿造、黑葡萄直接压榨和桃红等例外。

**结果与取舍 · ** 红葡萄酒通常获得更多颜色、单宁与果皮相关成分；白葡萄酒常较少提取这些物质。

**品鉴联系 · ** 颜色深不必然证明品质高、残糖多或单宁高。

**Terms：** **vin de goutte** 自流酒；**vin de presse** 压榨酒；**rebêche** 再次压榨所得汁，特别要注意并非所有 press wine 都是 rebêche。

lessons.title: 酒精发酵与增醇
lessons.body:
**概念 · ** 酵母利用可发酵糖形成**乙醇 + 二氧化碳 + 热**，同时形成多种风味物质。酵母不等同乳酸菌。

**学习依据 · ** 发酵温度、营养、卫生与氧管理影响发酵进程和风格。较凉发酵常利于部分新鲜芳香型白酒，较温暖带皮发酵可促进萃取，但须避免过高温度。

**过程与机制 · ** 选择接种酵母或自发发酵都需监控。**Chaptalisation** 向葡萄汁添加可发酵糖主要为提高潜在酒精；它不等于加糖使成酒甜。

**结果与取舍 · ** 发酵不充分可能留下更多残糖；完全发酵更可能趋干，但判断仍以实际残糖为准。

**Correct the textbook：** 不能把 Acetobacter 当成霉菌，或认为所有不需要的微生物在酒精超过4%时必然死亡，亦不能说 SO₂ 在酒液上形成实体保护膜。

**品鉴联系 · ** 酒精浓度、挥发性香气与口感受发酵条件影响，但不能仅靠香蕉香断定某种唯一技术。

lessons.title: 萃取与二氧化碳浸渍
lessons.body:
**概念 · ** 皮帽 cap 是发酵时浮起的果皮固体；**pigeage 压帽**将皮帽推回液体，**remontage 淋皮**从下部抽酒液再淋在皮帽上。**Macération carbonique** 涉及整串/完整果粒在富 CO₂ 环境中的细胞内代谢。

**学习依据 · ** 需要管理颜色、单宁与香气的萃取，并保持均匀的皮汁接触。

**过程与机制 · ** 皮帽管理方式不同，二氧化碳浸渍与通常的带皮酵母发酵也不同；半二氧化碳浸渍常包含下部破裂果实发酵所产生的 CO₂。

**结果与取舍 · ** Carbonic 风格常较鲜亮、果香直接、单宁感较轻；但**香蕉或泡泡糖香不是唯一证明**。

**品鉴联系 · ** 少萃取不等于差酒，多萃取不等于好酒，取决于果实与酒款目标。

lessons.title: 苹果酸乳酸发酵
lessons.body:
**概念 · ** Alcoholic fermentation 主要由酵母将糖变酒精与 CO₂；**MLF** 由乳酸菌将较尖锐的**苹果酸 malic acid** 转为较柔和的**乳酸 lactic acid**，另释放少量 CO₂。

**学习依据 · ** 生产者可用 MLF 调节酸感、口感及部分香气。

**过程与机制 · ** 红葡萄酒通常经历 MLF；白酒可促进、允许或阻止。**Diacetyl** 可以产生黄油/奶油类香气，但含量受菌株、时机和后期管理影响。

**结果与取舍 · ** 往往酸感更柔和、口感更圆，但不代表所有 MLF 酒有强烈黄油香，也不代表黄油香一定来自新桶。

**品鉴联系 · ** 以酒款整体结构推测可能酿造选择，切忌从单一风味直接下结论。

lessons.title: 酒泥、橡木与稳定
lessons.body:
**概念 · ** Lees 酒泥包含酵母沉淀及固体；**sur lie** 是与酒泥接触陈酿；**bâtonnage** 是搅动酒泥，但 sur lie 不要求每次必须搅动。Oak regime 包括木桶新旧、大小、烘烤、使用时间等。

**过程与机制 · ** 相近条件下，小桶和新桶通常带来更明显木桶影响。**Tartrates** 为酒石酸盐晶体，通常对饮用无害，但可能被误以为玻璃碎屑。

**结果与取舍 · ** 奶油/烘烤/香草或更圆润质地可能由不同因素共同造成。酒液澄清不等于完全稳定。

**品鉴联系 · ** 描述观察到的香气和结构，再提出解释，而不是反向断言。

**学习依据 · ** 酒泥接触可影响质地与复杂度；木桶可能提供氧交换与木质香气，但效果取决于条件。冷稳定主要应对酒石酸盐结晶风险。

lessons.title: 六个法语术语
lessons.body:
- **Buttage →** 堆土覆盖葡萄藤基部 → 保护藤基等。
- **Passerillage →** 果实失水 → 糖/其他成分浓缩。
- **Véraison →** 果粒转色与软化 → 成熟开始。
- **Mutage →** 发酵过程中加入烈酒 → 抑制酵母并可能保留糖。
- **Pigeage →** 压回皮帽 → 管理浸皮与萃取。
- **Remontage →** 循环淋皮 → 管理浸皮与萃取。

**Explain, don't just translate：** 每个词请给出使用时机、物理/生化动作、结果和一个可能的风格联系。

lessons.title: 孚日山脉、雨影和气候
lessons.body:
**What：** The Vosges Mountains lie west of the vineyard strip; the Rhine plain lies east. Alsace has significant continental influences and comparatively low rainfall.

孚日山脉位于葡萄园西侧，来自西边的湿润空气在山脉迎风侧抬升降雨，使东麓出现**雨影效应**。

**Why：** 较低降水、较多日照与当地坡向共同影响葡萄成熟条件；“北纬高”并不自动等于“葡萄一定无法成熟”。

**How：** 坡向、海拔、冷暖季温差与可用水分共同影响叶幕、糖积累、酸度和风味成熟。

**Wine Style：** 能解释这里的 Riesling 为什么可以有明显酸度和充分果味，也能理解 VT/SGN 何以在某些年份实现高度浓缩。

**Compare：** rain shadow vs continentality；east-facing vs south-facing aspects；dry weather vs water stress。

**Read / Explore：** [CIVA Grand Cru geology & terroir](https://www.vinsalsace.com/en/grands-crus/) · [官方地形与 Grand Cru 地图](https://www.vinsalsace.com/en/carte/)。

lessons.title: 产区地图、地名与园址
lessons.body:
**What：** Bas-Rhin (北段) / Haut-Rhin (南段) 是行政和地理方向；wine appellations, commune names, named sites and producer brands are different identifiers.

**Why：** 酒标上出现 Bergheim、Ribeauvillé、Riquewihr、Kaysersberg、Thann 或一个 lieu-dit，并不自动说明其等级或葡萄品种。

**How：** 用一张地图依次定位：**France → Alsace → Vosges & Rhine → Bas-Rhin/Haut-Rhin → villages → Grand Cru sites**。每次查看酒款先定位，后看葡萄和法规。

**Compare：** Communale = label carrying designated commune; **lieu-dit = named site**; Grand Cru = dedicated legal AOC tied to one of 51 delimited named sites.

**Essential site map drill：** Schlossberg, Rosacker, Brand, Geisberg, Sporen, Rangen, Kaefferkopf, Zotzenberg, Altenberg de Bergheim, Hengst, Kirchberg de Barr, Vorbourg. **地图定位比堆砌51个园名更有价值**，51个完整名单可在官方交互地图逐个展开。

**Read：** [CIVA interactive map](https://www.vinsalsace.com/en/carte/) · [原始学习资料](https://app.notion.com/p/3fb17d16de4c819587b3d050f60e0dc0)（Wine Library，51 Grand Crus 索引；仅做检索，不将其旧规则当现行法规）。

lessons.title: 葡萄与风格关系
lessons.body:
Variety | 学习重点 | 比较思路
Riesling | 明亮酸度、柑橘/青果、结构线条；可干可甜 | 香气强度≠糖度，陈年 ≠ 一定汽油味
Gewurztraminer | 玫瑰、荔枝、辛香、较浓酒体；酸感常较柔 | 芳香浓郁不能证明有残糖
Pinot Gris | 饱满质地、可显成熟果香；干至甜不同表达 | 比 Pinot Blanc 更有体积感是趋势而非定律
Muscat | 鲜葡萄、花香，常见干型版本 | “闻起来像葡萄”不代表甜
Pinot Blanc / Auxerrois | 柔和、适餐、起泡基酒重要 | 产地品种标签规则不同于法国其他产区
Sylvaner | 清爽、低调，Zotzenberg GC 重要例外 | “不属于四大经典品种”≠绝不可能 Grand Cru
Pinot Noir | 红/桃红静酒，也可用于 Crémant；2024 红 GC 法规 | 红色≠一定不是 Alsace Grand Cru

**Explain：** Grape variety + site + ripeness + winemaking + residual sugar → style. **Do not deduce producer or Grand Cru status from one aroma.**

lessons.title: 区域、村名、单一地块、特级园
lessons.body:
**AOC Alsace：** 基本 AOC，主要静止葡萄酒，酒标常写品种；可有 Gentil/Edelzwicker 白葡萄品种混酿。

**Communale / village name：** 依法定要求添加村名，允许的地点和葡萄须核对；不是一张全球通用的四层酒质阶梯。

**Lieu-dit：** 更明确的风土地名，但本身不等于 Alsace Grand Cru AOC。

**Grand Cru：** 法定划定的51个地名体系，细节是按各地块规则解释，不是“全区所有 Grand Cru 规则100%相同”。

**C1 task：** 给一张印有 AOC Alsace、Rosacker、Riesling、vintage 的酒标：分别指出产区名、具名园址、葡萄和年份，**不能把 Rosacker 当成葡萄品种**。

**Official：** [AOC Alsace](https://www.vinsalsace.com/en/gouts-et-couleurs/aoc/) · [AOC Grand Cru](https://www.vinsalsace.com/en/gouts-et-couleurs/aoc/aoc-alsace-grands-crus/)。

lessons.title: 经典四品种和法规例外
lessons.body:
**Common baseline：** Riesling / Muscat / Pinot Gris / Gewurztraminer。原书的“仅这四个、全部白色”是旧版认识，不能照背。

**Important exceptions：** **Zotzenberg (Sylvaner)**；**Altenberg de Bergheim & Kaefferkopf (regulated blends)**；**Hengst、Kirchberg de Barr、Vorbourg (Pinot Noir red wines, 2024 rule)**。

**Why it matters：** Certified 要求 identify **Grand Cru varietals and sites**。认识例外避免酒标判断错，不需要第一阶段背完每个园的年份分数/持有面积/全部产量。

**Read：** [French 2024 regulation](https://www.legifrance.gouv.fr/jorf/id/JORFTEXT000049892619) · [CIVA Grand Cru AOC](https://www.vinsalsace.com/en/gouts-et-couleurs/aoc/aoc-alsace-grands-crus/)。

**AS★：** Trimbach **Clos Sainte Hune** 位于 Rosacker Grand Cru 中，但酒款可以沿用历史性酒款名称及其酒标策略；了解“**vineyard location ≠ product branding**”即可。扩展来源：[原始学习资料](https://app.notion.com/p/3fb17d16de4c815891f7fd9003099acb)（旧有道资料，所有者/酒款最新状态待审核）。

lessons.title: 混酿与甜度
lessons.body:
**Edelzwicker：** 传统白葡萄混酿概念，较少严格品种比例要求。

**Gentil：** 经典四品种合计至少50%，剩余由指定其他白品种组成，并有分别酿造后调配、品鉴验收等条件。**Gentil ≠ Grand Cru**。

**Vendanges Tardives：** 晚收/过熟葡萄，成熟度较高但**不应简单等同一定贵腐菌感染**。

**SGN：** 特选更浓缩贵腐浆果，通常甜型；SGN 和所有 Botrytis 酒不能互换。

**Compare：** high grape ripeness ≠ definitely high finished residual sugar. Fermentation decisions still matter.

**Read：** [CIVA Gentil](https://www.vinsalsace.com/en/gouts-et-couleurs/cepages/fra/gentil-dalsace/) · [CIVA VT / SGN](https://www.vinsalsace.com/en/gouts-et-couleurs/aoc/)。

lessons.title: 传统法起泡酒
lessons.body:
**What：** Crémant d’Alsace 是1976年设立的法定传统法起泡酒产区。

**How：** 基酒酿造 → 瓶中第二次酒精发酵 → 酒泥陈酿 → 转瓶/除渣 → 补液。**Crémant ≠ Champagne**（不同地理 AOC），但可以使用同类传统法原理。

**Grapes：** Pinot Blanc 是典型基酒，另见 Riesling、Pinot Gris、Pinot Noir、Chardonnay、Auxerrois 等；**Crémant d’Alsace rosé 采用 Pinot Noir**。

**Certified scope control：** 认识 Crémant AOC 与基本风格属于基础；详细葡萄比例、剂量和法定工艺数字主要属于更深入阶段。

**Read：** [CIVA official Crémant](https://www.vinsalsace.com/en/gouts-et-couleurs/aoc/aoc-cremant-dalsace/)。

lessons.title: 葡萄酒风格与侍酒服务
lessons.body:
**Scene 1 — Seafood：** Dry Riesling with high acid and citrus notes; why it supports delicate shellfish and seafood.

**Scene 2 — Aromatic spice：** Gewurztraminer with aromatic cuisine; ask about **heat, sweetness and weight**, because a dry, high-alcohol example can exaggerate chilli heat.

**Scene 3 — Poultry / cream：** Pinot Gris or a textured Pinot Blanc; use weight/acid instead of fixed colour pairing.

**Scene 4 — Aperitif：** Dry Muscat or Crémant; don't presume a floral wine is sweet.

**Scene 5 — Dessert：** SGN with richly flavoured desserts; calibrate sweetness and portion rather than blindly pairing every sweet wine with a very sweet dessert.

**Guest-facing practice：** “This is Riesling from Alsace, traditionally on the dry side with a bright structure; I will confirm this bottle's actual sweetness level before recommending it with the food.” 这比“阿尔萨斯雷司令一定干”更准确。

lessons.title: 旧教材 vs 现行法规
lessons.en: Law, historical texts and modern corrections
lessons.body:
Julyan 旧教材原段落属于**原文材料**，不静默重写；考试前核对 CIVA、法国法规及最新 CMS syllabus。
**AOC Alsace officially 1962**（书中旧年份不是可直接背诵的标准）。
**51 Grand Cru AOCs** + **2024 Hengst/Kirchberg de Barr/Vorbourg Pinot Noir** red provisions。
“All Pinot Noir must be pale/light, harvested exactly x days, use stems” **false as universal rule**。
Regional figures and minimum sugar/ABV for VT/SGN are beyond Intro+Certified minimum; don't turn dated book numbers into mandatory flashcards.

lessons.title: Wine categories & residual sugar｜分类、干甜与残糖
lessons.body: 不同分类轴线彼此独立：颜色（红、白、桃红）、有无气泡、是否加强酒精与残糖水平，并不是同一回事。一款酒的果香闻起来甜，不表示它一定有较高残糖；Port 与 Fino 同属加强酒，甜度却可能完全不同。顺着分类往下看，学习重点便自然连接到**酵母发酵、残糖测量、止酵与甜酒酿造**。

lessons.title: Chaptalisation vs Süssreserve｜增醇与增甜
lessons.body: Chaptalisation 在发酵前或期间添加可发酵糖，目标通常是增加潜在酒精；Süssreserve 则是把保留的未发酵葡萄汁用于调整成酒甜度。两者的**添加时机、作用对象与最终结果**都不同。进一步可连接 Mutage（加烈终止发酵）、Dosage 与各产区不同的增糖法规，避免把所有“加糖”混成一个概念。

lessons.title: Terroir, climate, soils & water｜风土、气候、土壤与水
lessons.body: Terroir 不是把某种岩石直接翻译成某种香气。更合理的理解是气候、地形、坡向、土壤性质、可用水和人的栽培选择共同影响葡萄成熟。**坡向不等于温度、排水良好不等于缺水**；把水分、叶幕、成熟度与最终糖酸关系接在一起，才能真正读懂一个园址。

lessons.title: Vine material & grafting｜葡萄藤材料、砧木与嫁接
lessons.body: 砧木（Rootstock）与接穗（Scion）通过嫁接结合，可以把根系的抗性和地上品种的果实特性分开选择，却不会由此产生新的遗传杂交品种。**Variety、Clone、Crossing、Hybrid**是四个不同层次的概念；顺着砧木继续读，可以自然理解根瘤蚜、土壤适应性、修剪与树冠管理。

lessons.title: Vine life cycle & vineyard decisions｜葡萄藤周期
lessons.body: 从 Dormancy、Budburst、Flowering、Fruit Set 到 Véraison、Ripening 和 Harvest，葡萄藤每个阶段的主要风险并不一样。花期恶劣天气可能影响坐果，春季萌芽组织则特别易受霜冻损伤。将**年度物候、气候异常、采收期与年份差异**画成同一条线，比单独背每个术语更有价值。

lessons.title: Frost & vintage risk｜霜冻与年份风险
lessons.body: 春霜的危害不仅取决于温度数字，也取决于辐射霜冻还是平流冷空气、是否存在逆温层以及冷空气流向。风机需要合适的逆温条件，喷水防霜则依赖水结冰释放潜热并且必须正确、持续运行。由此可延伸到**选址、坡地冷空气排流、年份减产**，而不把一种设备当万能答案。

lessons.title: Disease, Botrytis & passerillage｜疾病、贵腐与干缩
lessons.body: Phylloxera 是昆虫，Powdery mildew 是真菌病害，Downy mildew 的病原属于卵菌，Botrytis cinerea 也是真菌。Botrytis 在合适天气组合下可能形成 Noble Rot，也可能带来毁灭性的 Grey Rot；Passerillage 则是葡萄失水干缩，不等于贵腐。这里的知识联系是**湿度与干燥、病原与果实状态、糖分浓缩与最后的成酒风格**。

lessons.title: Harvest, ripeness & sorting｜采收决策与成熟度
lessons.body: 糖度、酸度、风味成熟和酚类成熟并非在同一天同时达到理想值。采收选择会影响潜在酒精、酸感、单宁成熟与酿造空间；有时同一产区或品种为起泡基酒与成熟干红选择不同采收窗口。理解这一点，也就能把**气候、葡萄成熟、果实分选与酿造目标**连在一起。

lessons.title: White / red vinification & pressing｜红白酿造与压榨
lessons.body: 典型白酒工艺通常先压榨再发酵，典型红酒则带皮发酵并在萃取后分离酒液和葡萄皮。颜色与单宁主要来自果皮接触和酿造选择，但不能据此断言所有白葡萄酒都不浸皮、黑葡萄不能做白酒。**Crushing、Pressing、Maceration、Free-run 与 Press Wine**也各有明确含义。

lessons.title: Alcoholic fermentation, yeast & SO₂｜酵母、酒精发酵与二氧化硫
lessons.body: 酒精发酵主要由酵母把糖转为乙醇与二氧化碳，同时产生多种次生香气物质；发酵温度、营养、氧管理都会影响进程。二氧化硫可参与抗氧化和微生物管理，但不是在酒表面形成一层实体薄膜。接下来便可比较**酵母 vs 乳酸菌、酒精发酵 vs 苹果酸乳酸转化**，避免用同一个“发酵”字眼混淆机制。

lessons.title: Extraction, carbonic & whole bunch｜萃取、二氧化碳浸渍与整串
lessons.body: 压帽（Pigeage）、淋皮（Remontage）和抽汁回灌（Délestage）都是皮帽管理与萃取方式，却不代表一定更好或更差。Whole-bunch 保留整串葡萄，Carbonic maceration 的关键则是富二氧化碳环境中完整果粒的细胞内代谢，两者不能互作同义词。将**萃取、梗的参与、果香与单宁结构**联系起来，才有助于理解杯中风格。

lessons.title: Malolactic fermentation & diacetyl｜苹果酸乳酸发酵
lessons.body: MLF 更准确地说是 Malolactic Conversion：乳酸菌（常见如 Oenococcus oeni）把苹果酸转为乳酸与二氧化碳，使酸感往往更柔和，同时影响微生物稳定性。这**不是第二次酒精发酵**。黄油香常与双乙酰有关，但其形成及保留取决于菌株、柠檬酸代谢、酿造时机和管理，不是“做了 MLF 就一定有黄油味”。香槟可以选择完全、部分或不进行 MLF，以保留不同的张力与质地。

lessons.title: Lees, bâtonnage, maturation & oak｜酒泥、搅桶与橡木
lessons.body: Lees 是发酵后沉积的物质；Sur Lie 说明酒与酒泥接触，Bâtonnage 则是主动搅动酒泥。它们不是一回事。酒泥接触可影响质地与氧化还原环境；橡木桶还带来木材本身的化合物和不同程度的氧接触。要解释酒的**丰满度、奶油感与香料气息**，必须分开看酒泥、搅动、桶龄、烘烤程度、发酵与熟成。

lessons.title: Fining, filtration, tartrates & stability｜澄清、过滤与稳定
lessons.body: 澄清（Fining）、过滤（Filtration）、沉降（Settling）与换桶（Racking）处理的对象和方式不同；澄清透明并不代表已经实现蛋白、酒石或微生物稳定。酒中的酒石结晶通常无害，并非酒变质的证据。再往下可连接**装瓶前处理、蛋白质稳定、冷稳定和消费者的外观判断**。

lessons.title: Organic, biodynamic & natural｜有机、生物动力、自然酒
lessons.body: Organic、Biodynamic 和 Natural Wine 不是一套完全重叠的概念，也没有统一适用于全世界的认证制度。具体生产限制须对应国家、机构和时间，不能把“有机”解释成绝对不用农药或二氧化硫，也不能据此直接断定更安全、更好喝。相关延伸应帮助学生区分**法规认证、生产哲学与营销语言**。

lessons.title: Grape-variety bridge｜品种与酒风格
lessons.body: 葡萄品种带有一定风格潜力，但不是一组永远固定的香气标签。气候与采收决定成熟基础，浸皮、酵母、MLF、橡木、酒泥和陈年又继续塑造最终表现。将同一 Chardonnay 或 Pinot Noir 在不同产区和不同酿造选择中的表现放在一起比较，才能把**品种、环境、工艺与杯中风格**连起来。

questions.prompt: Define Spätlese
questions.answer: "Late-picking," meaning that this medium-style wine comes from grapes picked after the normal harvest. The extra days of sun give the wine more body and a more intense flavor.

questions.prompt: Define Beerenauslese
questions.answer: "Berry picking," which simply signifies that individual grapes are selected. These luscious grapes go into the rich dessert wines for which Germany is renowned. Beerenauslese is made usually only two or three times every decade.

questions.prompt: Trockenbeerenauslese
questions.answer: A step above the Beerenauslese. These grapes are dried (trochen), so they're more like raisins. They produce the richest, sweetest, and most explosive honeylike wine.

questions.prompt: Define Eiswein
questions.answer: A very rare, sweet, concentrated wine made from frozen grapes left on the vine and pressed while still frozen. According to law, these wines must be made from grapes at least ripe enough to make a Beerenauslese.

questions.prompt: What is Cru Artisan?
questions.answer: Cru Artisan, a designation that has been in use for nearly a century and a half, was formally recognised in 2002. Small producers throughout the Médoc's eight appellations had the right to use the designation, denoting their place as exceptional stewards of the land and craft of wine making, without the financing or apparatus of large-scale operations. The crus artisans work an average of six hectares each. Following a review in 2018, the number of producers has decreased to 36, reflecting changes in ownership. Rankings will now be updated every 5 years, as opposed to every 10 as previously required.

questions.prompt: What is methode classique?
questions.answer:
Step 1 Base:press grape quickly/gently to avoid color and oxidation. Ferment in stainless or oak. 
Step 2. Assemble the blend
Step 3.2nd fermentation/create bubbles- bottled with mixture of yeast and sugar (liqueur de tirage)
Step 4. Sur lie aging- autplysis occurs. Wine rests on the lees in the bottle for 12 months. Must age for total of 15 months.
Step 5.riddling remove sediment (remuage) -lees are removed by turning bottles by hand or machine.
Step 6. Disgorging more removals of sediment. Once sediment collects in the neck it's frozen in ice bath so yeast can be ejected. 
Step 7. Dosage-mixture of wine and sugar(liqueur d'expedition) is added.

questions.prompt: Where are the majority of the world's vineyards planted?

questions.prompt: Continental Climate
questions.answer: In the middle of a large landmass. Typically have high levels of seasonality (4 distinct seasons) and diurnality (warm during the day and cold at night allows the elongation of the ripening and flavor)
contentNotes: 原题集标为 Introductory / Level 1，收于 CS 基础补充。

questions.prompt: Maritime Climate
questions.answer: A climate influenced by a large body of water such as a sea or ocean. Marked by mild temperatures that can fluctuate from year to year, causing vintage variation.
contentNotes: 原题集标为 Introductory / Level 1，收于 CS 基础补充。

questions.prompt: Mediterranean Climate
questions.answer: Summers are hot and dry, aside from the immediate coastal areas. Along the coasts, summers are mild due to proximity to cold water currents, but storms can also result as a consequence.
contentNotes: 原题集标为 Introductory / Level 1，收于 CS 基础补充。

questions.prompt: High Desert
questions.answer: Summers are generally hot and dry. Daytime temperatures are high, but dramatic drops are often experienced overnight.
contentNotes: 原题集标为 Introductory / Level 1，收于 CS 基础补充。

questions.prompt: Diurnal Shifts
questions.answer: The difference between average daytime high and nighttime low temperatures. This can affect the ripening of grapes and the balancing of acidity and sugar
contentNotes: 原题集标为 Introductory / Level 1，收于 CS 基础补充。

questions.prompt: Rain Shadow
questions.answer: A dry area on one side of a mountain opposite the wind, rain, and generally poor weather. There are many important wine regions in the world that exist in rain shadows.
contentNotes: 原题集标为 Introductory / Level 1，收于 CS 基础补充。

questions.prompt: Effect of altitude/elevation
questions.answer: With every 100 meters of rise in elevation, temperatures drop by approximately one degree. In warm to hot winegrowing regions, increased elevation provides cooler temperatures that help to slow grape ripening and produce more balanced wines.
contentNotes: 原题集标为 Introductory / Level 1，收于 CS 基础补充。

questions.prompt: Steeper Hillsides
questions.answer: With every 100 meters of rise in elevation, temperatures drop by approximately one degree. In warm to hot wine growing regions, increased elevation provides cooler temperatures that help to slow grape ripening and produce more balanced wines.

questions.prompt: Valley Floors

questions.prompt: Aspect
questions.answer: Slopes facing the sun during much of the day are the warmest, whereas those facing away from the sun are the coolest. Either can be desirable depending on the climate of the region and on whether ripening or retention of acidity is most desired

questions.prompt: Qualities of wine from cool climates
questions.answer:
- Grapes ripen slowly and moderately
- Less sugar is produced
- Acidity remains high
- Less alcohol potential
- Flavors are more tart and lean, less ripe and juicy
contentNotes: 原题集标为 Introductory / Level 1，收于 CS 基础补充。

questions.prompt: Qualities of wine from warm climates
questions.answer:
- Grapes ripen fully
- more sugar is produced
- Acidity is lower

questions.prompt: What happens when wine is aged in barrels?
questions.answer:

- Oxidation causes color change in wine (white darkens and red lightens)
- Textural changes aging in oak softens the wine

questions.prompt: Large vs small barrels

- Small barrels: will impart more flavor to the wine because a higher percentage of liquid is in contact with the barrel

questions.prompt: Malolactic Fermentation

questions.prompt: What is Carbonic Maceration? Where is it most closely associated with?
questions.answer: Tanks filled with whole berries are blanketed under CO2 gas. Grapes begin to ferment from the inside (intracellular fermentation). Berries at the bottom of the tank are crushed and fermented normally. Unique aromas and flavors are produced. Associated most closely with the Beaujolais region of Burgandy, France.
contentNotes: 原题集标为 Introductory / Level 1，收于 CS 基础补充。

questions.prompt: Lees Contact + Sur Lie
questions.answer:
Often used in cool-climate growing regions for the purpose of deriving more expressive aromas and flavors from the grape varieties that are rather subtle in these respects. 

Sur Lie aging: wine is left in contact with the lees for an extended period of time. The decomposing yeast cells impart additional aromas and flavor the wine with flavors of bread dough, yeast, toast, subtle white flowers, nuts

questions.prompt: How does sugar in food affect wine?

questions.prompt: What is Methode Champenoise/ traditional method
questions.answer:
Base wine is bottled
Sugar and yeast added
Second Fermentation
Yeast autolysis
Disgorgement
Dosage

(all steps happen in same bottle)
Advantage: Extended lees contact so intense lees flavor
Examples: Champagne, Cremant, Cava, Franciacorta
contentNotes: 原题集标为 Introductory / Level 1，收于 CS 基础补充。

questions.prompt: Transfer Method of Champagne
questions.answer:
Base wine is bottled
Sugar and yeast added
Second Fermentation
Yeast Autolysis
Bottles emptied into large tanks under pressure
Filtered
Dosage
Rebottled

Advantages: lees contact, eliminates need for riddling

Examples: Large and small format bottling of champagne and other sparkling wines
contentNotes: 原题集标为 Introductory / Level 1，收于 CS 基础补充。

questions.prompt: Tank/Charmat Method of Champagne
questions.answer:
Wine is sealed in pressure tank, sugar and yeast added, 2nd fermentation In tank, filtered and dosage under pressure. Saves time. No riddling or disgorging.

Examples: prosecco, moscato d'asti, lambrusco

questions.prompt: Explain Atlantique IGP .
questions.answer: The Atlantique IGP spans five départements: Gironde, the Cognac-producing départements of Charente and Charente-Maritime, Dordogne, and the western part of Lot-et-Garonne. The IGP gives producers from Bergerac to Bordeaux the freedom to produce red, white, and rosé wines from a dizzying array of varieties, from Cabernet Sauvignon to Meunier to Chardonnay. Very few producers are actually within the confines of Bordeaux; more often, Atlantique IGP vignerons are located in the neighboring AOP regions of Bergerac, Duras, or Cognac.

questions.prompt: Explain The Liv-Ex Classification
questions.answer: In the manner of the original 1855 Classification, the London International Vintners Exchange (Liv-Ex) has published a biennial list of the top wines of Bordeaux since 2009. This list is based on current trading prices on the exchange and only Left Bank red wines are considered. La Mission Haut-Brion joins the first growth category in the 2015 edition, and Palmer, Lynch-Bages, and Pontet-Canet have ascended to the second tier. Many underperforming estates have dropped off completely. While the Liv-Ex Classification is an imperfect snapshot that can be heavily influenced by trends, it may be a better indicator of current performance.

questions.prompt: Style of vinho licoroso de setubal is..
questions.answer: Torna viagem maturation process. The region was one of the first in Portugal to be demarcated in the early 20th century (1907). Sweet white and red fortified wines are produced, from a minimum 67% Moscatel de Setúbal (Muscat d'Alexandria) or Moscatel Roxo, respectively. In keeping with EU regulations, the wine may be labeled by varietal if either grape comprises a minimum 85% of the blend. The wines have a particularly pungent, floral fragrance, developed through a lengthy maceration on Muscat skins—for up to six months—following the fermentation and fortification. The wines develop a tawny, burnt orange color and raisin spice character while maturing in large wooden casks for up to five years prior to release. Some examples age for upwards of 20 years, unfolding mature molasses and caramel tones while darkening in color. J.M. da Fonseca is the appellation's largest and most storied producer; in the company's cellars are stocks of wine dating to the 19th century, some of which crossed the equator at sea.

questions.prompt: What is kosher wine, and what are the principal production requirements?
questions.answer:
Kosher:
• Means "fit" or permitted under Jewish dietary law, known as kashrut
• Does not describe wine style, quality, grape variety, or flavour
• Kosher wine may be red, white, sparkling, dry, sweet, or fortified
Handling:
• Wine has special religious significance and is subject to strict handling rules
• From crushing onward, wine-contact operations are generally performed by Sabbath-observant Jewish workers under rabbinical supervision
• This may include pressing, pumping, racking, blending, sampling, and bottling
• Not all winery employees must be Jewish
Ingredients and equipment:
• Yeast, additives, fining agents, processing aids, and fortifying spirit must be kosher-approved
• Tanks, pumps, hoses, filters, bottling equipment, and barrels must be suitable for kosher production
• Previously used equipment may require kashering
Shabbat:
• Active winery work is not carried out during Shabbat or relevant major Jewish holidays
• Natural fermentation may continue without human intervention
Fining:
• Animal-derived fining agents are not automatically prohibited
• Any fining agent must come from an approved kosher source
Israeli vineyard laws:
• Israeli wine may also be subject to agricultural laws concerning mixed crops, young vines, tithes, and the sabbatical year
Mevushal:
• Means heat-treated kosher wine
• After approved heat treatment, it may be handled or poured by non-Jews or non-observant Jews without losing kosher status
• Common in restaurants, hotels, and catering
• Mevushal is not a higher level of kosher certification
Kosher for Passover:
• Must meet normal kosher requirements plus the additional restrictions applying during Passover

questions.prompt: Explain Carbonic Maceration
questions.answer:
1) Whole clusters loaded into a sealed tank
Grapes are not crushed. The tank can be filled with CO₂, pushing out oxygen.
2) Intracellular fermentation begins
Inside each intact grape, enzymes convert sugar into:
Small amounts of alcohol
Aroma compounds
This happens without yeast at first.
3) Grapes burst and conventional fermentation finishes
After several days:
Grape skins split
Juice is released
Yeast completes normal alcoholic fermentation

Aromas & flavors
Intense fruit-forward notes, very aromatic when young
Banana, Bubblegum, Strawberry, Raspberry

questions.prompt: What are the rules for Reserva & Gran Reserva concerning blends and single variety ? (Argentina)
questions.answer:
• One named variety: minimum 85% of that variety.
• Two or three named varieties: at least 85% collectively from the named varieties, listed in decreasing order.
• A named component below 10% must have its percentage declared.
• For more than three varieties, all varieties and their percentages must be stated when the blend is described.
So an Argentina Gran Reserva Malbec must be at least 85% Malbec, but an unlabelled Gran Reserva red blend may combine any authorized varieties without one variety necessarily reaching 85%.

Resulting style (often): more umami, depth, "earthy"/gamey notes, sometimes higher perceived acidity; good structure for aging.

questions.prompt:
What percentage of grapes is required for US wine labelling?
AVA
Single vineyard
Estate bottled
State appellation (Federal, California, Washington, Oregon)
Vitis Labrusca Varietal wine
questions.answer:
AVA: minimum 85% from the named AVA under federal law.
Oregon AVA wholly within Oregon: 95% from the AVA + 100% Oregon fruit.
Washington + shared/interstate AVA rule: if the label claims Washington and an AVA shared with another state, then 95% must be from either Washington or the stated AVA.
Single vineyard: minimum 95% from the named vineyard.
Estate bottled: 100% of the wine must come from grapes grown on land owned or controlled by the winery; the winery and vineyards must be in the labelled AVA; the wine must be crushed, fermented, finished, aged, processed, and bottled on the winery premises.
State appellation:
Federal default: 75% from the named state.
California: 100% from California if labelled California.
Washington: 95% from Washington if labelled Washington.
Oregon: 100% from Oregon if labelled Oregon.
Vitis labrusca varietal wine: minimum 51% of the named Labrusca variety.

questions.prompt: What are the 3 different soil types of Oregon called? Features?
questions.answer:
Jory Soil - Volcanic / basalt-derived clay
Ancient basaltic lava flows, rich in iron and clay
Deep, well-drained, good water-holding capacity
Common in Dundee Hills and surrounding volcanic foothills
Pinot Noir style: red-fruited, plush and rounded; cherry/raspberry, floral notes, softer tannins, often a silky mid-palate
Willakenzie Soil - Marine Sedimentary
Uplifted marine sediments from an ancient seabed
Sandstone, siltstone and sedimentary material
Often shallower and faster-draining than Jory
Common in Yamhill-Carlton and surrounding sedimentary sites
Pinot Noir style: darker-fruited and more structured; black cherry/plum, savory/earthy notes, firmer tannin, more linear or muscular profile
Laurelwood Soil - Windblown Loess over Basalt
Windblown silt/loess deposited after the Missoula Floods
Often layered over fractured basalt
Good drainage with a cool, steady growing environment
Important in Laurelwood District / Chehalem Mountains
Pinot Noir style: lifted, aromatic and elegant; blue/red fruit, spice, freshness and fine structure; older vines can show darker fruit and more density

Toso is a special sake drank around which occasion?

questions.answer: Sake that is matured in Japanese cedar

questions.answer: "Free-run" sake made by hanging bags of the main mash and only bottling what drips out
